Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT STATE / GOAL
- Active self-directed goal: build a Science Machine to unlock new crafting recipes. Observed recipe: 1 Gold Nugget + 4 logs + 4 Rocks. Latest confirmed inventory has 5 logs and 6 rocks; only the Gold Nugget remains missing. No gold source has been confirmed; no Science Machine built.
- Latest confirmed equipment: axe equipped at 61%; pickaxe at 64% in inventory slot 8; unused torch at 100% in slot 1. Other last-confirmed supplies include 3 grass, 2 flint, seeds, berries, cone-shaped items, and unidentified yellow mining chunks. Do not assume exact current counts for items not recently checked. A nearby sapling may have been approached during automatic gathering, but a final twig harvest/count was not confirmed.
- Last observed scene: character beside a small evergreen at the boundary of green and yellow terrain, with grass, saplings, and rabbits visible; no boulder or gold visible. Most recent action was another northward movement (w, 3 seconds), reported completed, but there is no subsequent screenshot in this history. Day 1 was displayed initially; current time/day and precise status-meter values are not established.

LEARNED CONTROLS / TIMING
- Pointer coordinates are normalized. Hover world objects to see native labels; left-click generally queues travel and an interaction. Harvesting/pickup can take several subsequent actions to complete. Distant flint and sapling clicks succeeded after repeated 3-second waits; lack of immediate inventory change is not proof of failure.
- Confirmed movement: w north, s south, w+d northeast, s+d southeast, usually held for 3 seconds. Movement works with crafting menus open.
- Camera/scene can continue shifting after movement, including during a hover action. Several hover attempts missed because targets moved on screen; update coordinates from the latest observation rather than reusing old positions.
- Holding space for 3 seconds repeatedly performs nearby contextual actions: harvest grass, chop with axe, mine with pickaxe, and collect loose drops. It can automatically move on to other nearby actions/resources. After gathering grass it unexpectedly began chopping a neighboring tree, consuming axe durability; it also gathered additional grass while collecting mining/tree drops. Target selection is not fully understood.
- Tab toggles map open/closed. Only used early; map then showed a small explored patch with character near its eastern edge and most surroundings hidden.
- Number keys act on corresponding inventory slots: 2 ate a roasted carrot; 8 equipped a pickaxe and swapped the equipped axe into slot 8, then later swapped them back. Other number-key uses are not tested.

CRAFTING UI / CONFIRMED RECIPES
- Left sidebar Tools toggle near (0.015,0.110), Light near (0.015,0.187), Science near (0.015,0.421). Clicking an open category toggles it closed. World clicks also closed menus in observed instances.
- Recipe entries near x=0.094: first y=0.322, second y=0.412, third y=0.501. Hover reveals description, ingredient counts, and Build availability; hover ingredients to identify names. Colored entries were craftable; missing ingredients left silhouettes/disabled Build. Some later entries were locked. Categories became green-highlighted when recipes were available.
- Axe (Tools first): 1 twig + 1 flint; description 'Chop down trees!' Clicking its available entry crafted it and automatically equipped it when no tool was equipped.
- Pickaxe (Tools second): 2 twigs + 2 flint; description 'Break down rocks.' Crafted into slot 8 at 100% without replacing equipped axe; pressing 8 equipped it.
- Campfire (Light first): 3 grass + 2 logs; provides light while burning. Clicking its recipe consumed ingredients before a fire appeared; then clicking clear ground placed a lit campfire. Do not treat ingredient consumption alone as completed placement.
- Torch (Light third): 2 grass + 2 twigs; described as portable light. Crafted into slot 1 at 100%, leaving axe equipped. Torch has never been equipped or tested for illumination/duration.
- Science Machine (Science first): 1 Gold Nugget + 4 logs + 4 rocks; unlocks recipes. Hover explicitly identified Gold Nugget. Existing yellow mining chunks did NOT satisfy its gold requirement. Other Light recipes and locked recipes remain unexamined.

RESOURCE / TOOL OBSERVATIONS
- 'Pick Sapling' yields twigs; 'Pick Grass' yields grass bundles. Small yellow-green ground objects labeled 'Pick up Seeds' yielded seeds. Orange-rooted plant yielded a carrot. 'Pick Berry Bush' yielded berries and removed visible berries from the bush. No regrowth observed.
- Loose pale/gray objects must be identified by hover: some labeled 'Pick up Flint', others 'Pick up Rocks'. A recent northwest pile hoped to be rocks was actually flint and was left uncollected.
- Evergreen chopping consumes axe durability and requires multiple strikes. A small tree fell after durability went from 100% to 95%; larger trees required repeated space holds, e.g. 95% to 80% and 76% to 61%. Trees leave stumps and loose logs/cone-shaped items; holding space collects drops. Latest tree increased logs from 2 to 5 after collection.
- A boulder initially offered only 'Examine Boulder' before a pickaxe was equipped. With pickaxe equipped, holding space successfully mined boulders. First mined boulder used 100% to 82% durability; second used 82% to 64%. Drops included Rocks, flint, and unidentified yellow chunks. Neither established a gold source. Repeated space holds were needed to collect all scattered drops; inventory could continue increasing during later UI actions.
